purpose: Explore the selected vehicle's FSM transitions and independent dwell-time summary for the workspace analysis window.
primaryGoal: Understand how the vehicle changed state, compare state dwell times and daily transition counts, inspect trigger evidence, and navigate to related records.

dataSources.name: useTimelinePageTimeline
dataSources.behavior: String selected-vehicle ID; encoded instant bounds; enabled only for nonempty ID; query key ['vehicle-timeline', activeId, startInstant, endInstantExclusive]; AbortSignal forwarded to request; no local retry, stale-time or polling override. Expected envelope contains transitions with ts/from_state/to_state/trigger_field/trigger_value.
dataSources.backendOwnership: Router constructs vehicleStatesHandler with VehicleStatesRepo; route comments identify fsm_transitions restricted to fsm_name='vehicle'. Handler/repository behavior, pagination/completeness and actual boundary filtering were not inspected.

dataSources.name: useTimelinePageSummary
dataSources.behavior: Independent query key ['vehicle-summary', activeId, startInstant, endInstantExclusive], same vehicle/range enablement and signal forwarding. Expected scalar envelope includes total_seconds and by_state rows with state, total_seconds, percentage, transition_count. SI seconds and returned percentages remain raw.
dataSources.backendOwnership: Same router-owned vehicleStatesHandler; coverage, missing-state meaning and dwell calculation remain unknown without handler/repository or runtime evidence.

dataSources.name: useVehicles
dataSources.behavior: Only the error is consumed by this page; query uses vehicleKeys.all, STALE_TIMES.FAST, safeArray and request AbortSignal. Exact /vehicles router registration was not inspected in this bounded audit; no endpoint mismatch is claimed.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle, date range and timezone
dataSources.behavior: Global selected vehicle; vehicle timezone; persistKey timeline.range; default 7d; startInstant/endInstantExclusive passed to both source hooks. No competing page picker. /timeline is registered in workspaceScope.ts:72. The hook implementations, actual URL persistence and DST behavior were not exercised.

components.name: PageLayout, CardGrid, LayoutCard
components.contract: One PageLayout delegates to PageContainer; four single-item full-width CardGrids supply accessible group labels; LayoutCard provides title association, container-aware padding and min-w-0 content. Retain page title/subtitle/header actions and all four full-width bands.

components.name: ChartCard and category chart exports
components.contract: ChartCard forwards children/data/dataColumns/state/size props into EmbeddedChart within LayoutCard. Page supplies four stacked bars, accessible label, UTC explanation, chartKey, hidden-series callbacks and source-state footer. Do not invent exports/fullscreen settings not explicitly supplied by the page.

components.name: OperationalBrief and useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: compact, timeline-summary testId, four source-backed metrics, source status/tone, scope/provenance and initial-loading suppression. The owner exposes a details Drawer; its source includes loading suppression in both summary and drawer. Adapter implementation and mounted interactions were not inspected.

components.name: TimelineSource
components.contract: Facts enabled/available/loading/paused/error plus label/children; source-local skeleton, selection prompt, error, paused, unknown debugger recovery, retained error and retained paused notices. Preserve independent neighbors.

components.name: CompositionRail
components.contract: size lg; summary; unique segment IDs; label/detail/color/widthPercent/hideFromTrack. Validates finite 0-100 segment widths; hiding small decorative fills retains every readable legend entry. Supports fillClassName and caller CSS colors.

components.name: MetricBar
components.contract: label/value/max/color/sublabel; default gradient fill; existing fill='solid' supports theme variables. Uses progressbar semantics and reduced-motion preference. Page owns dwell arithmetic, missingness and formatting.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: embedded; stable tableId analytics:timeline-transitions; value filters; six columns; pagination; mobile columns/roles/displayValue/onOpenRow/inlineActions/allDetails. Shared persistence/sort/resize/reorder/export capabilities remain owner-controlled; effective mounted export behavior was not verified.

components.name: EntityPreviewDrawer
components.contract: open/onClose; localized eyebrow/title/description; destination status; five evidence fields; seven related links. Delegates overlay behavior to Drawer; shared Close action and link-click closure are source-present.

components.name: DataFreshnessAuto
components.contract: timelineQuery only; default refetchable=true. Existing props query/source/compact/refetchable/forceStaleAfterMs permit source-specific metadata without a replacement freshness engine.

components.name: Badge, Button, Text, Caption; feedback; FadeIn
components.contract: Preserve semantic state badges, localized action names, minimum-height page inspect/refresh controls, typography roles, empty/error notices and six entrance wrappers. Primitive implementations beyond the listed page-specific owners were not independently audited.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The distribution has CompositionRail's returned-state legend plus a hand-built eight-state palette key. They overlap but are not equivalent: the static key includes states absent from returned rows.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all eight category meanings and all returned duration/percentage details; compose the established category/legend owner rather than silently dropping the static key. No speculative new shared component is justified by this one consumer.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The inspected page-specific barrel still exports an alternate TimelineSummary with the same four occurrence IDs and a StatStrip/text-duration pipeline, while the mounted page uses OperationalBrief/numeric duration metrics.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep OperationalBrief as the mounted summary owner. Resolve alternate adoption/removal only with confirmed callers; do not revert the page to text metrics or claim this export is globally unused.

issues.rule: MDC-043: long content and narrow containers
issues.detail: The time-by-state header places the visible state and formatted duration/percentage in a single justify-between flex row without an explicit wrap strategy. Long localized labels or large percentages are a source-level narrow-container risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Use the existing header contract first; test 320px/200%-text/RTL/long state names and, if reproduced, have the MetricBar owner add wrapping/min-width behavior without dropping labels or readouts.

TimelinePage.tsx:514,531-537 supplies chart accessible name and data columns.

issues.detail: Related-context links explicitly use h-10 (40px), smaller than the page's min-h-11 inspect/refresh controls. WCAG spacing exceptions and actual hit geometry were not measured.
issues.fix: Existing EntityPreviewDrawer owner should use a minimum 44px link target that can grow for long labels; retain Link semantics, BUTTON_BASE/outline treatment, every destination and onClose/onNavigate.

issues.rule: MDC-044: localized presentation without source recasing
issues.detail: Time-by-state labels capitalize raw state identities; badges, distribution and preview expose raw identities, while duration helpers emit literal h/m/s suffixes and nonlocalized digits. Raw state evidence is legitimate, but the presentation has inconsistent localization/recasing.
issues.fix: Keep raw state/trigger identities in data/export/details; use the existing localized state-label and formatting policy for presentation, preserving specialist single-rounding behavior and exposing raw evidence where needed.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard order, focus trap/restoration, screen reader output, chart alternative reachability, composed contrast, forced colors and reduced-motion behavior NOT RUN.

states.initialLoading: Independent summary OperationalBrief loading at page:427 and TimelineSource skeleton at dependency:41-45; chart loading at page:515; permanent sections retained.
states.empty: Valid empty distributions/dwell lists/table/chart retain their frame and section-specific copy at page:442-446,516-525,568-572,608.
states.unavailableOrUnknown: Array shape determines transition/summary availability at page:155-171. TimelineSource distinguishes no vehicle, malformed/missing envelope, paused and errors; unknown response can link to /state-debugger.
states.fatalError: Independent source ErrorDisplay/ChartCard error with retained neighbors; vehicles error is a separate AlertBanner. Error recovery is uneven.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: TimelineSource.tsx:52-58 retains children with a warning. Daily chart uses footer warning at page:526-529; summary labels retained source rather than replacing the metric region.
states.offlinePaused: Page passes each query's isPaused separately; TimelineSource has no-data paused and retained-paused branches; reconnect behavior remains TanStack-owned and was not exercised.
states.stale: Header DataFreshnessAuto describes timelineQuery only; no summaryQuery successful-fetch age is shown. Retained summary errors/pauses are source-present, not proof of freshness.
states.disabled: Both domain hooks disabled for empty vehicle ID; TimelineSource asks for workspace vehicle selection. Page refresh and freshness remain rendered without an explicit enabled guard.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045: unavailable measurement is not zero
issues.detail: Any by_state array, including empty, is considered available. Missing driving/charging rows default to zero at lines 261-268 and summary rawValues become numeric zeros at lines 269-288, even while the distribution/dwell panels report no state data. An array shape alone does not prove observed zero dwell or continuous coverage.
issues.fix: Resolve the summary endpoint's empty/missing-state semantics with its integration owner. Preserve legitimate measured zeros, but pass null/missing reasons when dwell is unobserved; never infer completeness from the requested window.

issues.detail: Both the refresh icon and default-refetchable DataFreshnessAuto target only timelineQuery. Summary-dependent metrics/distribution/dwell have no supplied manual retry or successful-fetch age; TimelineSourceFacts has no retry field and ErrorDisplay is not passed an onRetry callback.
issues.fix: Keep source independence; add an explicit summary refetch/retry and source-labeled summary freshness using existing DataFreshnessAuto and feedback APIs, without changing query keys/policies or treating timeline freshness as summary freshness.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010/MDC-034 and mission 43: restrained semantic color
visualIssues.detail: Eight fixed hex state colors include chromatic emerald, cyan, amber, blue and purple. The same palette drives distribution/key/dwell/chart; bars use 0.85 opacity and MetricBar defaults to gradient fill. These bypass theme-aware palette ownership and can create saturated multicolor noise. Actual rendered saturation/contrast is unverified; semantic differentiation must survive.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse canonical state/chart semantic colors and subdued theme-aware surfaces, preserve state identities and series visibility, and use MetricBar's existing fill='solid' when passing CSS variables. Do not concatenate alpha suffixes onto var(...) through the default gradient path or reset saved chart/theme preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Both chart axes hardcode fontSize 10, outside the shared typography preference pipeline. Tick color already uses --text-muted; effective readability is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Use current chart typography tokens/preference-aware defaults while retaining UTC day labels, integer count axis and preserveStartEnd/minTickGap behavior; test long labels and small widths.

architectureIssues.detail: The page comment says cancellation is unforwarded, but the inspected current useTimelinePage hooks forward signal in both request calls at lines 47-50 and 66-69. This is stale documentation, not a cancellation defect.
architectureIssues.fix: Correct the local comment when the page is modernized; retain hook-owned AbortSignal forwarding and original cache/enablement policies.

architectureIssues.detail: Range labels explicitly use vehicle timezone, but previewDay calls localDayKey without timezone; table and preview timestamps call formatDateTime without overrides. dateFormat.ts documents browser defaults. Related day links may describe a different calendar day from the vehicle-scoped analysis window near midnight.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve and consistently apply the existing vehicle timezone and saved locale at the presentation/context-link boundary; retain explicitly UTC daily aggregation and its explanatory subtitle rather than silently changing buckets.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045: preserve and distinguish inferred versus measured duration
architectureIssues.detail: Table/preview duration is derived from the next fetched transition or Date.now() for the last row. A historic bounded result's last row can therefore extend to the present outside the requested end; there is no explicit timer in this page. This is separate from summary dwell, and successor availability beyond the requested window is unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the integration owner resolve the intended current-state versus bounded-history duration contract. Preserve original evidence and disclose incomplete successor coverage; do not silently alter summary arithmetic or claim inferred table duration equals measured window dwell.

architectureIssues.detail: A 771-line page combines query/source adaptation, transition ordering, UTC aggregation, state arithmetic, specialist duration formatting, table rendering and context-link assembly. Typed hooks and several canonical presentation owners are already correctly separated.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract only page-specific pure derivations and render contracts into the existing feature structure, maintaining all six content regions, four metrics, raw SI, query policies, IDs, exports and actions. Do not introduce another summary/formatting/query engine.

priority.reason: Resolve zero-versus-unobserved summary measurements, bounded duration interpretation and independent summary recovery before aesthetic consolidation. Existing layout/chart/table/preview/source owners already provide substantial modernization coverage.

competingImplementations.fix: Resolve confirmed consumers under the feature owner; keep mounted numeric-source OperationalBrief and specialist duration rounding. This audit does not authorize deletion.

actions: Workspace vehicle selection and View settings date range remain shell-owned
Table time/from/to/trigger sorting; value filters; pagination; shared persistence/export capabilities
Chart legend/hidden-series interaction through timeline-daily-breakdown key
Desktop Inspect and mobile row-open/inline Inspect
Mobile shared quick-view details including trigger_value
Related /signals with preview-day from/to and trigger-field signal selection
dataBehavior: No fixtures or fabricated measurements; preserve raw transition identities, nullable triggers and SI seconds.
Keep two independent vehicle/range query keys, nonempty-ID enablement, inherited policies and AbortSignal forwarding.
Retain defensive array-shape checks and source-local retained-data warnings without hiding neighbors.
Sort transitions ascending for successor duration math independently of table sort; retain original raw records and current index keys until explicit identity-contract review.
Daily buckets are UTC dates; count destination states; online/parked/idle fold into idle and asleep/sleeping/offline into sleeping; invalid timestamps are skipped.
Summary counts sum returned transition_count; dwell comes from summary, not timeline transition counts; idle and sleep group all original six states.
Retain single rounding to total minutes before h/m split and sub-minute rounded seconds; do not reintroduce 60m/60s boundary errors.
Distribution uses total_seconds denominator, guards nonfinite/negative/oversized individual dwell, and preserves individual evidence when proportional display is invalid.
Small rail segments omit only decorative track fill, never their readable details.
Unknown completeness remains unknown; resolve zero/missing-state and latest-row inference issues explicitly rather than silently changing calculation contracts.
Keep timeline.range, analytics:timeline-transitions, timeline-daily-breakdown, timeline-summary and all four occurrence IDs.
